about: Task 26.2: the electricity reference as a reference-analysis model answer (boxes in thousandths, from recreate_electricity.json) with the agreed split: bar bottom, area right and the region fixed_size_list native; headline, KPI text, globe and legends static. Replaces the observation fixture's vision reply once 26.5 retires it.
instructions: Region Selector = region, chart fixed_size_list. Region = region. Country = country. Access to electricity = AVG(access_pct), unit %, date grain year using year. have access to electricity = AVG(access_pct), unit %, date grain year using year. People without access to electricity = SUM(people_without_access), date grain year using year. Philippines = AVG(urban_pct) and AVG(rural_pct), unit %, chart area, date grain year using year. Morocco = AVG(urban_pct) and AVG(rural_pct), unit %, chart area, date grain year using year. Fiji = AVG(urban_pct) and AVG(rural_pct), unit %, chart area, date grain year using year. Belize = AVG(urban_pct) and AVG(rural_pct), unit %, chart area, date grain year using year. Urban = AVG(urban_pct), unit %, date grain year using year. Rural = AVG(rural_pct), unit %, date grain year using year.
